# Americans Who Tell The Truth

> > A portrait project by artist Robert Shetterly honoring courageous Americans who speak truth to power on social justice, civil rights, environmental justice, and democracy.

Founded by artist Robert Shetterly, AWTT features painted portraits and stories of activists, whistleblowers, and truth-tellers including Bill McKibben, John Lewis, Harriet Jacobs, Frederick Douglass, and Ida B. Wells. The project includes educational resources, exhibitions, and museum-grade prints celebrating those who fight for justice and accountability.

## Key Topics

- Social Justice
- Environmental Justice
- Civil Rights
- Climate Activism
- Portrait Art
- Whistleblowers
- Democracy
- Indigenous Rights
- Racial Justice
- Political Commentary
- Truth-Telling
- Activism
- Robert Shetterly
- Food Justice
- Anti-War Movement

## Featured Activists & Portrait Stories

- [Thomas Jefferson: One Man, Two Legacies](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/thomas-jefferson-one-man-two-legacies): Thomas Jefferson's slavery legacy explored through Monticello portrait display
- [20th Anniversary of the Attack on Iraq](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/20th-anniversary-of-the-attack-on-iraq): Robert Shetterly reflects on Iraq War crimes and accountability 20 years later
- [Catching up with Bryan Stevenson](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/catching-up-with-bryan-stevenson): Bryan Stevenson's Equal Justice Initiative and Legacy Museum work update
- [Leah Penniman: Star Power](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/leah-penniman-star-power): Leah Penniman's food justice work and Black urban farming advocacy profile
- [Black History Month: AWTT Gallery Welcomes New Portraits](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/black-history-month-awtt-gallery-welcomes-new-portraits): New portraits of John W. Jones, Harriet Jacobs for Black History Month
- [Nikki Giovanni at 78](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/nikki-giovanni-at-78): Poet Nikki Giovanni's 78th birthday and Black Arts Movement contributions

## Environmental & Climate Justice

- [Earth Advocates: Zeitgeist Matters](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/earth-advocates-zeitgeist-matters): Earth justice portrait subjects' climate activism ahead of book publication
- [Indigenous and Environmental Activists Continue Fight Against Line 3](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/indigenous-and-environmental-activists-continue-fight-against-line-3): Indigenous rights activists and Bill McKibben resist Enbridge Line 3 pipeline
- [Kim Wasserman's Latest Battles](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/kim-wassermans-latest-battles): Kim Wasserman fights asphalt plant in McKinley Park for environmental justice
- [Tim DeChristopher on State of the "Necessity" Defense](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/tim-dechristopher-on-state-of-the-necessity-defense): Tim DeChristopher discusses necessity defense in climate activism cases

## Democracy & Political Commentary

- [News Flash! U.S. Loses World War II!](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/news-flash-u-s-loses-world-war-ii): Commentary on fascism's return 80 years after WWII and democracy threats
- [John Kiriakou Portrait Unveiling](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/john-kiriakou-portrait-unveiling): CIA whistleblower John Kiriakou portrait unveiling event by Robert Shetterly
- [Can We Divest from Weapons Dealers?](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/can-we-divest-from-weapons-dealers): Kathy Kelly calls for divestment from weapons dealers and gun violence

## Indigenous & Tribal Justice

- [Maulian Dana Receives Award for Tribal Justice and Advocacy](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/maulian-dana-receives-award-for-tribal-justice-and-advocacy): Maulian Dana honored for Penobscot Nation tribal justice advocacy work

## Social Justice & Equity

- [Cruel Threats to Hungry Families and Children](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/cruel-threats-to-hungry-families-and-children): Marian Wright Edelman on SNAP cuts and child poverty from Children's Defense
- [5 UC Berkeley Experts Pick Library Materials to Help us Reflect on Juneteenth](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/5-uc-berkeley-experts-pick-library-materials-to-help-us-reflect-on-juneteenth): UC Berkeley scholars recommend books on Juneteenth and African American history
